read.title: Answering Customer Questions on Amazon
read.text:
Customer questions on the product page are a great chance to build trust. Try to reply to every inquiry within 24 hours, because unanswered questions can lower conversion.

Keep your answers short and factual. For example, if a shopper asks whether a toner is fragrance-free, answer clearly and mention the key ingredients. Never make medical claims such as "cures acne."

For skin concerns, we recommend suggesting a patch test before regular use. Finally, check older answers every month and update them when the formula changes.

write.en: Answer an Amazon customer who asks whether your cream is okay for sensitive skin.
write.model: Great question! Our Cica Calming Cream is fragrance-free and was tested on sensitive skin. However, everyone's skin is different, so we recommend doing a patch test on your inner arm before using it on your face. Thank you for your interest!
